La moment Aici e mai bine ca acasa!

I only had positive interaction. I had no conflicts, usually people switch to Russian when they see that I do not understand Romanian. I am glad there are different opportunities to learn Romanian and come to different activities. I feel like home here. I do not feel like I am in a foreign country. We often talk to each other, as we all miss home, and we give each other advice on where to find different opportunities. We have to help each other.
